solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Visible **means being able to be seen or perceived; noticeable or observable. (दृश्यमान)

 
 
• **Example**: *The stars were clearly visible in the night sky, shining brightly against the dark backdrop.*
 
 
 
• The use of "**visible**" in the given context suggests that the results of these healthy practices can be observed or noticed. It implies tangible, noticeable changes in physical or mental well-being.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

• **Invisible: **Unable to be seen; not visible to the naked eye. (अदृश्य)
 
• **Gentle: **Mild, kind, or soft in action, effect, or degree. (कोमल)
 
• **Sluggish: **Slow-moving, lacking energy or alertness, or characterized by a slow response. (आलसी)
